However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? Question: Asalam o Alaikum. Dear Brother, can you tell me what is the best time for praying, I mean dua .. I heard that sajda is the best time, when Salah was orderd the companions of Prohphet Mohammad (saw) were happy saying we got a source through which we cas ask from Allah. And also I heard that *Harzat Mohammad (saw) very few times after praying made dua.. So can we have dua while praying salah during sajda.... Please give reference of Hadees or Quran Ayaa... Answer ID: 9345 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2329/1911=B/1429) According to Hadith, there are many times when dua is accepted, for example after every obligatory salah , at the time of Tahajjud, between the time of Azan and Iqamah , when it starts raining, while in a journey, doing dua after praising Allah and reciting durood , doing dua in the sajdah of nafl salah. In the sajdah, one should recite only the duas which are narrated from the Prophet ( (صلى الله عليه وسلم , it is not allowed to do dua in sajdah in Urdu language. The Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) used to pray after every obligatory salah : أللهم أنت السلام ومنك السلام You should study in the books of Ahadiht the chapter: باب ما يقول بعد السلام , you will find many traditions there. Also, there is a special chapter named ابواب الدعوات containing a number of duas . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
